item.title: Ask HN: Claude Desktop Weird Behavior
item.summary: I had a Claude session going on on my mac on thedesktop app. I also had a separate session on a separate project on my Windows machine, again on Claude Desktop app. Mac session finished a fix for a web app and started testing, to my surprise web site launched on my Windows machine. Any idea why? Is it the remote functionality in play? I don't remember setting it up. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49326276 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
